                                                               PRESS NOTICE



         NON EXERCISE OF THE POST-AUCTION OPTION FACILITY  1⅞% INDEX-LINKED TREASURY
                                                                  GILT 2049





 There were no additional amounts of 1⅞% Index-linked Treasury Gilt 2049 purchased during the Post-Auction Option Facility
 window. The total amount outstanding of 1⅞% Index-linked Treasury Gilt 2049 (ISIN Code: GB00BT7J0134) will remain at
 £8,424.999 million (nominal) from the auction settlement date.
